author: AbstractEnt
title: Looking for 2D Pixel Artist for Fighting Game
content:
LOOKING FOR A 2D PIXEL ARTIST!

Hey everyone! I’m looking for a talented 2D pixel artist to help bring The Blood of Champions: A New Fighting Era to life!

I’m specifically looking for someone who specializes in RPG-style roaming animations, walking sprites, and detailed pixel art backgrounds and environments to help expand the world of our game.

I’m planning to commission someone in the next few weeks, so if you specialize in this kind of work, I’d love to check out your portfolio! I’m excited to connect with artists and find the right fit for the project.

Interested? Drop your portfolio in the replies or send me a DM! Retweets are greatly appreciated to help spread the word. No spams I will not reply!

author: NATURE TALKS BACK™
title: Call for Illustrators for Holiday Collection
content:
🎄 Calling all artists! We need you! 🎨

Okay, we know we’re cutting it close! 😂

We’re excited to expand our Nature Talks Back™ artist community with a new creative voice for a special holiday collection!

We already have four holiday concepts developed and are looking for a talented illustrator to bring them to life in their own original, hand-drawn style.

We’re looking for someone who loves wildlife, appreciates a little humor, and can create a cohesive collection.

🌲 Target launch: November 1!

This is a royalty-based collaboration, with compensation details discussed privately.

Interested? Send us a DM with your portfolio and a little about yourself!

Know an artist who might be perfect? Tag them or share this post! ❤️
